description.value: A second colony lying about four kilometres downwind of the first, in coarser rubble and on a thinner dust supply, and the one that has carried the larger share of the exchange since 2299. It gives its own age as considerably greater than the register's figure, which is simply the year it was first met. Whether it and its neighbour are two persons or one is a question both of them decline as badly formed, having exchanged bodies during every flood on record.

notes.value: The two heaps are entered separately because the survey met them separately, which is the only defence the entry has and is stated here in full.
